editorial.name: Kolors
editorial.descriptionZh: Kolors是Souhail Benlhachemi制作的设计系统配色工具，页面展示基础色阶及背景、边框、文字的语义token映射，并声明支持导出。此轮只核现有色阶与背景角色映射，未操作生成或导出，费用与许可仍未知。
editorial.descriptionEn: Kolors by Souhail Benlhachemi presents base color scales and semantic mappings for design-system backgrounds, borders and text. The page advertises primitive and semantic token export. Current scales and background mappings were visually reviewed; generation, editing and export were not tested. Price, software licensing and output commercial terms remain unknown.
editorial.takeawayZh: 查看基础色阶到语义角色的映射
editorial.noteZh: 我们先看首页标题与灰阶，再下滚比较Primary蓝紫和Secondary绿色阶，当前两组的浅深编号与色值均可辨。Color Roles里可见neutral-50连到background-canvas，也有Surface和Inverse映射，适合核对设计系统命名。本次未改色、生成或导出；已核原源未给费用、软件许可及输出商用条款。

reasons.statement: 精确入口呈现设计系统基础色与语义token关系，当前可见Primary/Secondary色阶及Canvas/Surface/Inverse具体映射；原页声明primitive与semantic tokens导出，按design-to-code-handoff归类，不把可读色值或编译脚本当程序开源或已验证文件交付。
